CHK-006.reason: The seam prompt strip (.f1-prompts, Enter Select / G Intel / Q Defend / P Pause) was read at the first command menu of every link, with the HUD root's f1-over class (PR-0598). Link 1 passes everywhere (opacity 1, no f1-over). From link 2 on the strip is opacity 0 and the HUD root carries f1-over, in every chain read: Den of Woe links 2 and 3 of 3; Isaaru links 2 and 3 of 3; Leblanc links 2 and 3 of 3; Fallen Aeons (FFX-2 XI) links 2 and 3 of 3 (round 32 had it keeping its prompts; it now draws the F1 HUD and loses them); Braska links 2 to 7 of 7 (seed 2; the seed 1 run did not leave link 1 inside 5.5 minutes); Trema link 2 of 2 on seeds 2 and 3 (seed 1 lost link 1). Screenshots at every link show the strip present at link 1 and absent after. No other overlay is left over: the same f1Cue and f1Hero counts (1 and 1) are visible at link 1 and at every later link, so nothing extra is painted over the HUD at a seam. Supporting: the target step cancels back to the same awaiting menu in all four accessibility runs (Enter, Escape). Not read: the Sin, Mirror Aeons and Ixion chains and the hidden chains (the four FFX hidden chapters have no strip at all, PR-0644). 0 console errors, 0 404s in any seam run.
CHK-006.linkedIssue: PR-0598 (still open, unchanged by release 76); smallest fix as filed: clear f1-over when the next link begins.

PR-0597.reason: ACCESSIBILITY walked by real input in four runs (Chapter I FFX and Chapter IV FFX-2, each at 1600x900 by keys and at 390x844 by touch taps on the pause chip, the tab and the rows; 56 to 58 checks each, 0 failed in desk-ffx-ch1-v2, desk-ffx2-ch4-v2, phone-ffx-ch1-v2; phone-ffx2-ch4 has 2 harness-spec misses, my 'whole tab strip inside the window' test, which is wrong for a strip that scrolls). TEXT SIZE 100 -> 115 -> 130, REDUCE MOTION, REDUCE FLASHES, LOW EFFECTS, COLOUR VISION OFF -> RED-GREEN -> BLUE-YELLOW, one at a time, each: the row says it (OFF -> ON, 100% -> 115% -> 130%, ...), <html> carries it (data-text-size and -wide, data-reduce-motion, data-reduce-flashes, data-low-effects, data-colour-vision), and a first-menu screenshot behind each pause. MEASURED EFFECT: TEXT SIZE scales the live HUD type by 1.15 and 1.30 (FFX desktop median 1.15 and 1.30 over 98 classes; FFX-2 desktop 51 of 98 classes at 1.15 and 44 of 87 at 1.30 by effective size, the FFX-2 HUD scales by a transform; phone 5 to 10 classes); REDUCE MOTION shortens the HUD's transitions (0.26 s -> 0.001 s on pf-mom__bar and pf-mom__slab; 2 to 9 classes changed per run) and fx.reduceMotion false -> true; LOW EFFECTS drops the stage tier full -> low (fx.tier and fx.lowEffects in all four runs; FFX desktop 4 plates -> 2, depth of field and fog off); COLOUR VISION writes 9 --cvd-* variables (red-green) and 7 changed ones (blue-yellow), and the enemy colour is drawn at the target step on the FFX phone (9 to 10 turn-order tile outlines) and on FFX-2 desktop (4 elements; the reticle brackets are the enemy yellow in 92b-after-reload-target-step.png). PERSISTENCE: after a real page reload the saved settings equal the pre-reload ones, <html> carries all five on the first frames at the title, the HUD is still at 130% at the first menu, and the pause rows still read 130% / ON / ON / ON / BLUE-YELLOW, in all four runs. NOT SHOWN: REDUCE FLASHES' visible effect (the flag reaches the fx environment, fx.reduceFlashes false -> true, but an idle first menu has no pulse or flash for it to soften; a flash event was not driven) and COLOUR VISION's colours at the FFX-2 phone target step and on the FFX desktop target step (the phone FFX-2 Enter opened Yuna's White Magic submenu; the FFX desktop run predates the target read). One harness fact: on a touch context Escape did not open the pause in 4 attempts (FFX Chapter I in the first accessibility run and in the phone sweep; both games in text-floor-sweep); a real phone has no Escape, and the HUD's pause chip opened it on the first tap in all 8 opens of the phone Chapter I rerun and in both phone-pause-tabs runs.
